9554177:*** A special note about internal error number 1007 ***
9554234:Experience suggests that a common cause of i.e. 1007
9554287:is unreliable memory or other hardware.  The 1007 assertion
9554347:just happens to cross-check the results of huge numbers of
9554406:memory reads/writes, and so acts (unintendedly) as a stress
9554466:test of your memory system.
9554495:I suggest the following: try compressing the file again,
9554552:possibly monitoring progress in detail with the -vv flag.
9554611:* If the error cannot be reproduced, and/or happens at different
9554676:  points in compression, you may have a flaky memory system.
9554737:  Try a memory-test program.  I have used Memtest86
9554789:  (www.memtest86.com).  At the time of writing it is free (GPLd).
9554855:  Memtest86 tests memory much more thorougly than your BIOSs
9554916:  power-on test, and may find failures that the BIOS doesn't.
9554979:* If the error can be repeatably reproduced, this is a bug in
9555041:  bzip2, and I would very much like to hear about it.  Please
9555103:  let me know, and, ideally, save a copy of the file causing the
9555168:  problem -- without which I will be unable to investigate it.
